Row model. `TsvVariantResultsWriter` walks `GeneScoreRanker.rankedVariants()`: one gene score per compatible mode, and under each, every variant compatible with that mode. A variant compatible with both dominant and recessive therefore appears twice, once per `MOI`. Collapsing rows to `CONTIG|START|REF|ALT` within a gene recovers the unique variant; the set of `MOI` values across its rows recovers

claims.claim: The alleles passing every filter in both lanes (Tier A) were already determinable from the disclosed replay-2 and specialist-packet outputs before this rule was written, so which alleles sit in the top tier was knowable at writing time.

The official scorer awards a full match unconditionally: `if full_match_rank is not None: rank_points = float(_rank_to_points(full_match_rank))` / `elif partial_match_rank is not None: rank_points = 0.5 * _rank_to_points(partial_match_rank)`.
A full match at rank 4 scores 25. A partial match at rank 1 scores 50.
A brute-force check over 1,843,650 scored combinations was run against the pinned official bytes, with scripts and results under verification/scorer-hedging/.
